issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode silently changed from EXTERNAL to FIXED breaks existing callers.
issues.detail: Flipping the InputParams default changes endpointing behavior (VAD emission, finalization triggers) for every caller relying on the default. The changelog files this under 'fixed' but it is a behavioral contract change without a deprecation path. Call it out explicitly as a breaking default and consider a transitional warning when the default is taken.

issues.description: process_frame now only finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, narrowing the accepted contract.
issues.detail: The base STTService contract previously finalized on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame; this subtype now only responds to the VAD variant. Callers wiring non-VAD producers will silently lose finalization. Either accept both frame types or document the stricter precondition at the supertype boundary.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED referenced but not visibly imported; invariant coupling two enums is unspecified.
issues.detail: _enable_vad checks EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED with no new import shown, risking AttributeError if the SDK 0.0.99 upgrade does not actually provide it. The implicit invariant 'FIXED/EXTERNAL disables internal VAD' lives only in a list literal and should be written down at the class boundary or the two enums unified.

issues.description: Patch bundles three independent changes — split for bisectability.
issues.detail: The diff combines the VAD frame-type switch, the FIXED default flip with new enum value, and the split_sentences/SpeechSegmentConfig wiring. Each is independently reviewable and revertable; bundling makes future bisection painful. Land as three separate diffs.

issues.description: split_sentences default unconditionally overrides vendor speech_segment_config default.
issues.detail: config.speech_segment_config is always replaced with SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=False) when params.split_sentences is None, clobbering any upstream VoiceAgentConfig default. Prefer setting only when params.split_sentences is not None, and replace `or False` with explicit bool coercion to make intent clear.

issues.description: Docstrings for turn_detection_mode are inconsistent and do not specify FIXED vs EXTERNAL semantics.
issues.detail: The class-level docstring updated FIXED as default but still frames EXTERNAL as Pipecat's built-in endpointing, contradicting the prior model. A reader cannot tell what guarantees FIXED versus EXTERNAL provide. Add a one-paragraph contract for each mode.

synthesis.summary: Panel verdict: NEEDS-WORK. The PR mostly wires a new SDK version but silently mutates two contracts — the default endpointing mode flips from EXTERNAL to FIXED, and finalization now only triggers on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame — both of which alter behavior for existing callers without a deprecation path. EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced without a visible import, and the FIXED/EXTERNAL-to-VAD-disable invariant now spans two enums with no written specification. The patch should be split into three independently bisectable diffs, the new contracts documented, and split_sentences should only override the vendor config when explicitly set.
